# Stand Firm in the Battle
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul’s closing words to the Corinthians read like a commander’s final briefing before deployment. He doesn't tell us to feel strong—he commands us to *act* like men. That means standing firm when your marriage is strained, when your job feels futile, and when your faith seems dry. Watchfulness is not paranoia; it is intentional awareness of where the enemy prowls. Faith is not a feeling; it is a position you refuse to abandon. Strength is not natural bravado; it is the disciplined choice to obey God when every instinct screams otherwise.

You are a warrior, not a victim. The battle is real, but so is the victory already secured in Christ. Today, you will face a moment where you must choose: retreat into comfort or advance in obedience. Choose the advance. Stand firm, not in your own grit, but in the unshakable truth that the God who called you is faithful to hold you.

## Daily Challenge
Do 30 pushups today—one for each year of your life (or 30 total if you’re under 30)—and with each rep, whisper, "I stand firm in Christ."
